source_title: Top Substack Writers Depart For Patreon

snippets.snippet_text: "Lenz said she is already about 70% of the way to what her paid subscriber rate had been at Substack within two weeks on the new platform."
"Sole-Smith said almost 50% of her subscribers had made the transition."
"She appreciated that when readers have subscriptions issues, they can talk to an 'actual support person — not a bot.'"
